{{ill|Jōtōsai|ja|上棟祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōtōsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 上棟式}}, {{ill|Kotsukisai|ja|杵築祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kotsukisai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}, {{ill|Gochinsai|ja|後鎮祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gochinsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}, {{ill|Sengyo|ja|遷御|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sengyo|qq=}}, and {{ill|Hōhei|ja|奉幣|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hōhei|qq=}} were scheduled according to the divine decision (*{{ill|Gojijō|ja|御治定|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gojijō|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*) of the reigning emperor。 Additionally, on [[:en:February 22|February 22]], the *{{ill|Oshiraishi-mochi|ja|お白石持|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oshiraishi-mochi|qq=}}* ceremony took place, during which approximately 1,000 participants from the {{ill|Miyago Hōkendan|ja|宮後奉献団|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyago Hōkendan|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} carried sacred stones (*{{ill|Oshiraishi|ja|御白石|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oshiraishi|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*) in a cart from the {{ill|Urakuchi Intersection|ja|浦口交差点|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Urakuchi Intersection|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} to {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月夜見宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|2=ja|3=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}}, covering a distance of 1.2 km{{Cite web|和書|url=http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|title=次代につなぐ「エンヤ」 伊勢・月夜見宮でお白石持行事|author=中平雄大|publisher=[[中日新聞]]|date=2015-02-23|accessdate=2015-03-08|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150307161058/http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|archivedate=2015-03-07}}。 This marked the Completion tier 5]] A '''narrow, 4-meter-wide straight path''' connects the '''North Gate (北御門, Kita-mikado) of the Outer Shrine''' to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. This road is known as '''"Kamiji Street" (神路通り, Kamiji-dōri), meaning "Path of the Gods,"''' as it is '''believed to be the route taken by deities.''' See {{ill|Kamiji Street|ja|神路通り|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamiji Street|qq=}} for details. --- == Worshipers' Association (信者団体) == In '''1960 (Shōwa 35)''', a group of '''Ise City residents''' founded the '''Tsukiyomi-[[Kō (lecture)|kō]] (月夜見講)''', which was later renamed the '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Hōsankai (月夜見宮奉賛会, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Worshipers' Association).''' - This organization '''holds annual thanksgiving festivals''' on '''April 19 and September 19''', among other activities. --- == Access (交通) == * '''Train:''' ** '''10-minute walk''' from '''[[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]''' (served by '''JR [[:en:Sangū Line|Sangu Line]]''' & '''Kintetsu [[:en:Yamada Line (Kintetsu)|Yamada Line]]'''). ** '''5-minute walk''' from the '''North Gate of the Outer Shrine''' via '''Kamiji Street'''. * '''Bus:''' ** '''3-minute walk''' from '''Shindō Bus Stop''' ('''[[:en:Mie Kotsu|Mie Kotsu]] Bus'''). ** '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae Bus Stop''' (served by the '''{{ill|Ise City Community Bus|ja|伊勢市コミュニティバス|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise City Community Bus|qq=}}'''). ** Note: From '''July 20, 2013''', the '''Sangu Bus''' operated by Mie Kotsu stopped at '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae''', but this service was '''discontinued on March 31, 2015'''. * '''Car:''' ** '''Approx. 3 km''' from '''{{ill|Ise Interchange|ja|伊勢インターチェンジ|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise Interchange|qq=}} (Ise Expressway).''' ** '''Parking:''' There are '''only 2-4 parking spaces in front of the torii gate''', but '''metered parking''' is available on the south side of the street. --- == References == {{Reflist}} == 参考文献 == * 『月夜見宮参拝のしおり』（発行：神宮司庁） * 『お伊勢さんを歩こう』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『お伊勢まいり』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『宇治山田市史』 * 金子延夫『玉城町史 二巻 －南伊勢の歴史と伝承－』三重県郷土資料叢書第91集、三重県郷土資料刊行会、昭和58th year 12月10日 * 出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編『[[るるぶ]] お伊勢まいり』るるぶ情報版近畿21、通巻4615号、[[JTBパブリッシング]]、2014th year 5月1日、92p. ISBN 978-4-533-09761-4 * [[三橋健 (神道学者)|三橋健]]『伊勢神宮 日本人は何を祈ってきたのか』[[朝日新書]]416、[[朝日新聞出版]]、2013rd year 8月30日、230p. ISBN 978-4-02-273516-4 * 矢野憲一『伊勢神宮―知られざる杜のうち』角川選書402、[[角川学芸出版]]、平成18th year 11月10日、270p. ISBN 4-04-703402-9 * 『伊勢神宮』楽学ブックス 神社1、JTBパブリッシング、2011th year 4月1日、143p. ISBN 978-4-533-08206-1 * 『日本人なら知っておきたい 伊勢神宮と125の社』タツミムック、[[辰巳出版]]、2013rd year 11月1日、127p. ISBN 978-4-7778-1197-7 * 『いま行く!伊勢神宮お参りパーフェクトブック』みらい出版、2013rd year 12月10日、107p. ISBN 978-4-907292-14-0 == See Also == * [[:en:ツクヨミ|ツクヨミ]] * {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|ja|伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * {{ill|List of 125 Shrines of Ise|ja|神宮125社の一覧|lt=List of 125 Shrines of Ise|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|3=伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of 125 Shrines of Ise|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * [[神路通り]] == External Links == {{commonscat|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}} * [http://www.isejingu.or.jp/about/geku/tsukiyomi.html 月夜見宮] - 伊勢神宮公式サイト * [http://www.jingukaikan.jp/125mairi/m02/0202.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや） - 神宮会館] - 一般財団法人伊勢神宮崇敬会 * [http://www.ise-kanko.jp/base_data/base_data.php?info_cd=00269 伊勢市観光協会/月夜見宮] * [http://www.barifuri.com/tourcenter/data_kankou/tsukiyomi_1/index.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや）] - 伊勢志摩バリアフリーツアーセンター {{125 Shrines of Ise}} *)。 == Shrine Grounds (境内) == * '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (月夜見宮)''' - A '''Betsugū''' (auxiliary shrine) of {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]). The shrine’s '''architecture follows Shinmei-zukuri''' and features '''chigi (forked finials) cut horizontally''' and '''five katsuogi (short decorative logs)''', '''a thatched roof''', and '''a south-facing orientation'''. ** '''Shikinen Sengu (式年遷宮)''': The shrine is '''reconstructed every 20 years''' according to the ancient practice of '''Shikinen Sengu'''. The '''former shrine grounds''' (古殿地, kodenchi) are located directly to the east and west of the current shrine. ** '''Traditional Legend''': It is said that in the past, when the people of '''Miyago Town''' were carrying '''sacred timber (役木, yakugi)''' for shrine reconstruction, they '''passed through Yokaichiba Town'''. At that moment, '''a fire broke out in Miyago Town''', and the timber carriers '''rushed back to extinguish it'''. As a result, the people of Yokaichiba took over the role of '''carrying the sacred timber'''. Since then, in the '''Okihikizome-shiki (御木曳初式, First Timber-Carrying Ceremony)''', '''the people of Yokaichiba''' have traditionally taken on the '''honor of bringing the sacred timber to Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. * '''{{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}}''' - Dedicated to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto no Mitama (月夜見尊御魂, Spirit of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto)'''. Though located within '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''', it is actually '''a Sessha (摂社, auxiliary shrine) of Toyouke Daijingu (Outer Shrine).''' * '''{{ill|Inari Shrine|ja|稲荷社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神社}}''' – A shrine dedicated to '''Inari''', the deity of '''prosperity and agriculture'''. * '''Shukueya (宿衛屋)''' – A '''guardhouse''' for shrine officials. --- == Kamiji Street (神路通り) == [[File:Kamiji Street from Tsukiyomi no Miya.jpg|thumb|Kamiji Street]] }} {{translated page|ja|月夜見宮|qq=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|qq=ja|qq=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|version=99549095|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category: of the *Oshiraishi-mochi* ceremonies for all auxiliary shrines (*{{ill|Betsugū|ja|別宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Betsugū|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} [[ja:月夜見宮]] [[sn:Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)]] [[Category:Built in Japan in 2015]] [[Category:Shikinaisha in Ise Province]] [[Category:Shrines in Ise City]] [[Category:125 Shrines of Ise]] {{Commons category|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}}

{{distinguish|{{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|ja|月讀宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|2=es|3=Tsukiyomi no miya (Naikū)|4=ja|5=月讀宮|lkt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|qq=}}}} {{混同|月讀宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|2=es|3=Tsukiyomi no miya (Naikū)|4=ja|5=月讀宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya}} {{神社 | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Geku Tsukiyomi no Miya in October 2016.jpg|270px]]
社殿 |名称 = 月夜見宮 |所在地 = [[三重県]][[Ise, Mie]]宮後一丁目3-19 |位置 = {{ウィキ座標2段度分秒|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E|display=inline,title}} |祭神 = [[:en:ツクヨミ|月夜見尊]]
月夜見尊荒御魂 |社格 = {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳}}（小）
{{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}別宮 |創建 = [[延長 (元号)|延長]]5th year （[[927]]）以前 |本殿 = [[神明造]] |例祭= |地図 = {{location map|Japan Mie|lat_deg=34|lat_min=29|lat_sec=34.7|lon_deg=136|lon_min=42|lon_sec=21.3|label=月夜見宮|position=top|width=200|float=center|caption=|mark=Shinto torii icon vermillion.svg|marksize=20}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E}}}} }} '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''' (月夜見宮) is a [[Shinto shrine|shrine]] located in Miyago, Ise City, Mie Prefecture辰巳出版（2013）：16ページ. It is a [[:en:Betsugū|Betsugū]] of [[Ise Grand Shrine|Ise Jingu]] {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine)伊勢文化舎 編（2008）：39ページみらい出版（2013）：64ページ学研パブリッシング（2013）：69ページJTBパブリッシング（2011）：42ページ出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編（2014）：34ページ三橋（2013）：124ページ。 It is a [[Shikinaisha]]. == Overview == [[File:Tsukiyomi-nomiya(Geku)_00.JPG|thumb|300px|right|Aerial view of Tsukiyomi-no-Miya]] Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is an auxiliary shrine (betsugu) of the Outer Shrine (Geku), located about 300 meters north of Geku and approximately 500 meters west of [[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]. It enshrines two deities within the same shrine building: {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} (Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) and his fierce spirit, '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Aramitama''' (荒御魂 of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) . Unlike the {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|ja|月讀宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|qq=}} auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naiku), where Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto and his Aramitama are enshrined separately, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya uniquely houses both deities within a single structure . The only other auxiliary shrines that enshrine two deities in one building are {{ill|Kaze-no-Miya|ja|風宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaze-no-Miya|qq=}} (Kaze-no-Miya) of the Outer Shrine and {{ill|Kazahinomi-no-Miya|ja|風日祈宮|lt=Kazahi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-no-Miya|qq=}} of the Inner Shrine, both enshrining Shinatsuhiko-no-Mikoto (級長津彦命) and Shinatsuhime-no-Mikoto (級長戸辺命). Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is the only auxiliary shrine of the Outer Shrine located outside the main precincts . Despite being in the urban area of Ise City, its grounds maintain a serene atmosphere . The moat surrounding three sides of the precinct is thought to be a remnant of a tributary of the [[:en:Miya River (Mie)|Miyagawa River (Mie Prefecture)]] . The {{ill|Mie Prefectural Route 37|ja|三重県道37号鳥羽松阪線|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mie Prefectural Route 37|qq=}} runs along the northern side of the moat and serves as the route for the '''Hatsuhobiki''' (初穂曳), a festival procession held every October in conjunction with the [[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]. During this event, decorated carts carry the first harvested rice offerings to the Outer Shrine. Adjacent to the right rear of the shrine building is the auxiliary shrine of {{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}} . To the left rear stands an {{ill|Inari shrine|ja|稲荷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神}} , and to the right is a large sacred camphor tree (大楠), where many people offer prayers . Like other auxiliary shrines outside the main precincts, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya has a '''Shukueiya''' (宿衛屋), a guardhouse where Shinto priests are present during visiting hours to distribute amulets, offer kagura performances, and manage food offerings (御饌). == Worshipped Deities (Saijin) == {{see also|{{ill|Saijin|ja|祭神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saijin|qq=}}}} * [[:en:Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto]]（つきよみのみこと） * {{nihongo|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Ara-Mitama|月夜見尊荒御魂}} : {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} is the same deity as {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月讀尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}}, the enshrined deity of {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月讀宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}}, an auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naikū) of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]. He is the brother of [[:en:Amaterasu|Amaterasu Ōmikami]]. Since agricultural activities historically relied on the lunar calendar ([[:en:Lunar calendar|Lunisolar calendar]]), he has been worshipped as a deity of agriculture. Additionally, he is also considered a river deity of {{ill|Takagawara|ja|高河原|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara|qq=}} and a deity associated with women. According to the *{{ill|Jinmyō Hisho|ja|神名秘書|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jinmyō Hisho|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*, his [[:en:Shintai|Shintai]] (sacred object) is a [[:en:Mirror|mirror]]. == Festivals == The shrine follows a festival schedule similar to that of {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|ja|皇大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, with offerings from the [[:en:Imperial House of Japan|Imperial House of Japan]] during prayers for the harvest (*[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]*), seasonal festivals (*{{ill|Tsukinamisai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinamisai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}*), and major thanksgiving ceremonies (*[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* and *[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]*). * '''January''' **{{ill|Saitan-sai|ja|歳旦祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saitan-sai|qq=}}* (New Year's Festival) – [[:en:January 1|January 1]] *** A festival celebrating the new year and praying for the eternal prosperity of the imperial lineage. **{{ill|Genshi-sai|ja|元始祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Genshi-sai|qq=}}* (Imperial Foundation Festival) – [[:en:January 3|January 3]] *** A festival celebrating the origins of the imperial rule. * '''February''' **{{ill|Kenkoku Kinen-sai|ja|建国記念祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kenkoku Kinen-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (National Foundation Festival) – [[:en:February 11|February 11]] *** Celebrating the founding of Japan by [[:en:Emperor Jimmu|Emperor Jimmu]]. **[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]* (Prayer Festival) – [[:en:February 18|February 18]] *** A ceremony held early in the year to pray for abundant grain harvests and national peace. **{{ill|Tenchō-sai|ja|天長祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenchō-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天皇誕生日}}* (Emperor’s Birthday Festival) – [[:en:February 23|February 23]] *** A festival honoring the birthday of {{ill|Emperor Naruhito|ja|徳仁天皇|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Naruhito|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 徳仁}}. * '''May''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:May 14|May 14]] *** Offerings are made at the Outer Shrine, Inner Shrine, and affiliated shrines to pray for protection from storms and a bountiful harvest. * '''June''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:June 18|June 18]]–[[:en:June 19|June 19]] *** A biannual festival held in June and December to pray for the well-being of the nation and the emperor. Together with *[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]*, these are called the *Three Great Festivals* (三節祭 or 三時祭). * '''August''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:August 4|August 4]] *** A repetition of the May festival to pray for good weather and agricultural prosperity. * '''October''' **[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* (First Fruits Festival) – [[:en:October 18|October 18]]–[[:en:October 19|October 19]] *** A festival where priests present freshly harvested grains as offerings to the gods. * '''November''' **[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]* (New Harvest Festival) – [[:en:November 24|November 24]] *** A festival in which the emperor offers the season’s first grains to the gods and partakes in them as an act of gratitude. * '''December''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:December 伊勢・月夜見宮でお白石持行事|author=中平雄大|publisher=[[中日新聞]]|date=2015-02-23|accessdate=2015-03-08|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150307161058/http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|archivedate=2015-03-07}}。 This marked the Completion tier 5]] A '''narrow, 4-meter-wide straight path''' connects the '''North Gate (北御門, Kita-mikado) of the Outer Shrine''' to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. This road is known as '''"Kamiji Street" (神路通り, Kamiji-dōri), meaning "Path of the Gods,"''' as it is '''believed to be the route taken by deities.''' See {{ill|Kamiji Street|ja|神路通り|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamiji Street|qq=}} for details. --- == Worshipers' Association (信者団体) == In '''1960 (Shōwa 35)''', a group of '''Ise City residents''' founded the '''Tsukiyomi-[[Kō (lecture)|kō]] (月夜見講)''', which was later renamed the '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Hōsankai (月夜見宮奉賛会, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Worshipers' Association).''' - This organization '''holds annual thanksgiving festivals''' on '''April 19 and September 19''', among other activities. --- == Access (交通) == * '''Train:''' ** '''10-minute walk''' from '''[[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]''' (served by '''JR [[:en:Sangū Line|Sangu Line]]''' & '''Kintetsu [[:en:Yamada Line (Kintetsu)|Yamada Line]]'''). ** '''5-minute walk''' from the '''North Gate of the Outer Shrine''' via '''Kamiji Street'''. * '''Bus:''' ** '''3-minute walk''' from '''Shindō Bus Stop''' ('''[[:en:Mie Kotsu|Mie Kotsu]] Bus'''). ** '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae Bus Stop''' (served by the '''{{ill|Ise City Community Bus|ja|伊勢市コミュニティバス|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise City Community Bus|qq=}}'''). ** Note: From '''July 20, 2013''', the '''Sangu Bus''' operated by Mie Kotsu stopped at '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae''', but this service was '''discontinued on March 31, 2015'''. * '''Car:''' ** '''Approx. 3 km''' from '''{{ill|Ise Interchange|ja|伊勢インターチェンジ|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise Interchange|qq=}} (Ise Expressway).''' ** '''Parking:''' There are '''only 2-4 parking spaces in front of the torii gate''', but '''metered parking''' is available on the south side of the street. --- == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * 『月夜見宮参拝のしおり』（発行：神宮司庁） * 『お伊勢さんを歩こう』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『お伊勢まいり』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『宇治山田市史』 * 金子延夫『玉城町史 二巻 －南伊勢の歴史と伝承－』三重県郷土資料叢書第91集、三重県郷土資料刊行会、昭和58th year 12月10日 * 出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編『[[るるぶ]] お伊勢まいり』るるぶ情報版近畿21、通巻4615号、[[JTBパブリッシング]]、2014th year 5月1日、92p. ISBN 978-4-533-09761-4 * [[三橋健 (神道学者)|三橋健]]『伊勢神宮 日本人は何を祈ってきたのか』[[朝日新書]]416、[[朝日新聞出版]]、2013rd year 8月30日、230p. ISBN 978-4-02-273516-4 * 矢野憲一『伊勢神宮―知られざる杜のうち』角川選書402、[[角川学芸出版]]、平成18th year 11月10日、270p. ISBN 978-4-7778-1197-7 * 『いま行く!伊勢神宮お参りパーフェクトブック』みらい出版、2013rd year 12月10日、107p. ISBN 978-4-907292-14-0 == See Also == * [[:en:ツクヨミ|ツクヨミ]] * {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|ja|伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * {{ill|List of 125 Shrines of Ise|ja|神宮125社の一覧|lt=List of 125 Shrines of Ise|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|3=伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of 125 Shrines of Ise|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * [[神路通り]] == External Links == {{commonscat|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}} * [http://www.isejingu.or.jp/about/geku/tsukiyomi.html 月夜見宮] - 伊勢神宮公式サイト * [http://www.jingukaikan.jp/125mairi/m02/0202.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや） - 神宮会館] - 一般財団法人伊勢神宮崇敬会 * [http://www.ise-kanko.jp/base_data/base_data.php?info_cd=00269 伊勢市観光協会/月夜見宮] * [http://www.barifuri.com/tourcenter/data_kankou/tsukiyomi_1/index.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや）] - 伊勢志摩バリアフリーツアーセンター {{125 Shrines of Ise}} *)。 == Shrine Grounds (境内) == * '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (月夜見宮)''' - A '''Betsugū''' (auxiliary shrine) of {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]). The shrine’s '''architecture follows Shinmei-zukuri''' and features '''chigi (forked finials) cut horizontally''' and '''five katsuogi (short decorative logs)''', '''a thatched roof''', and '''a south-facing orientation'''. ** '''Shikinen Sengu (式年遷宮)''': The shrine is '''reconstructed every 20 years''' according to the ancient practice of '''Shikinen Sengu'''. The '''former shrine grounds''' (古殿地, kodenchi) are located directly to the east and west of the current shrine. ** '''Traditional Legend''': It is said that in the past, when the people of '''Miyago Town''' were carrying '''sacred timber (役木, yakugi)''' for shrine reconstruction, they '''passed through Yokaichiba Town'''. At that moment, '''a fire broke out in Miyago Town''', and the timber carriers '''rushed back to extinguish it'''. As a result, the people of Yokaichiba took over the role of '''carrying the sacred timber'''. Since then, in the '''Okihikizome-shiki (御木曳初式, First Timber-Carrying Ceremony)''', '''the people of Yokaichiba''' have traditionally taken on the '''honor of bringing the sacred timber to Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. * '''{{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}}''' - Dedicated to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto no Mitama (月夜見尊御魂, Spirit of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto)'''. Though located within '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''', it is actually '''a Sessha (摂社, auxiliary shrine) of Toyouke Daijingu (Outer Shrine).''' * '''{{ill|Inari Shrine|ja|稲荷社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神社}}''' – A shrine dedicated to '''Inari''', the deity of '''prosperity and agriculture'''. * '''Shukueya (宿衛屋)''' – A '''guardhouse''' for shrine officials. --- == Kamiji Street (神路通り) == [[File:Kamiji Street from Tsukiyomi no Miya.jpg|thumb|Kamiji Street]] }} {{translated page|ja|月夜見宮|qq=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|qq=ja|qq=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|version=99549095|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category: of the *Oshiraishi-mochi* ceremonies for all auxiliary shrines (*{{ill|Betsugū|ja|別宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Betsugū|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} [[ja:月夜見宮]] [[sn:Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)]] [[Category:Built in Japan in 2015]] [[Category:Shikinaisha in Ise Province]] [[Category:Shrines in Ise City]] [[Category:125 Shrines of Ise]] {{Commons category|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}}

{{distinguish|{{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|ja|月讀宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|2=es|3=Tsukiyomi no miya (Naikū)|4=ja|5=月讀宮|lkt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|qq=}}}} {{混同|月讀宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|2=es|3=Tsukiyomi no miya (Naikū)|4=ja|5=月讀宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya}} {{神社 | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Geku Tsukiyomi no Miya in October 2016.jpg|270px]]
社殿 |名称 = 月夜見宮 |所在地 = [[三重県]][[Ise, Mie]]宮後一丁目3-19 |位置 = {{ウィキ座標2段度分秒|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E|display=inline,title}} |祭神 = [[:en:ツクヨミ|月夜見尊]]
月夜見尊荒御魂 |社格 = {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳}}（小）
{{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}別宮 |創建 = [[延長 (元号)|延長]]5th year （[[927]]）以前 |本殿 = [[神明造]] |例祭= |地図 = {{location map|Japan Mie|lat_deg=34|lat_min=29|lat_sec=34.7|lon_deg=136|lon_min=42|lon_sec=21.3|label=月夜見宮|position=top|width=200|float=center|caption=|mark=Shinto torii icon vermillion.svg|marksize=20}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E}}}} }} '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''' (月夜見宮) is a [[Shinto shrine|shrine]] located in Miyago, Ise City, Mie Prefecture辰巳出版（2013）：16ページ. It is a [[:en:Betsugū|Betsugū]] of [[Ise Grand Shrine|Ise Jingu]] {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine)伊勢文化舎 編（2008）：39ページみらい出版（2013）：64ページ学研パブリッシング（2013）：69ページJTBパブリッシング（2011）：42ページ出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編（2014）：34ページ三橋（2013）：124ページ。 It is a [[Shikinaisha]]. == Overview == [[File:Tsukiyomi-nomiya(Geku)_00.JPG|thumb|300px|right|Aerial view of Tsukiyomi-no-Miya]] Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is an auxiliary shrine (betsugu) of the Outer Shrine (Geku), located about 300 meters north of Geku and approximately 500 meters west of [[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]. It enshrines two deities within the same shrine building: {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} (Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) and his fierce spirit, '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Aramitama''' (荒御魂 of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) . Unlike the {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|ja|月讀宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|qq=}} auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naiku), where Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto and his Aramitama are enshrined separately, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya uniquely houses both deities within a single structure . The only other auxiliary shrines that enshrine two deities in one building are {{ill|Kaze-no-Miya|ja|風宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaze-no-Miya|qq=}} (Kaze-no-Miya) of the Outer Shrine and {{ill|Kazahinomi-no-Miya|ja|風日祈宮|lt=Kazahi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-no-Miya|qq=}} of the Inner Shrine, both enshrining Shinatsuhiko-no-Mikoto (級長津彦命) and Shinatsuhime-no-Mikoto (級長戸辺命). Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is the only auxiliary shrine of the Outer Shrine located outside the main precincts . Despite being in the urban area of Ise City, its grounds maintain a serene atmosphere . The moat surrounding three sides of the precinct is thought to be a remnant of a tributary of the [[:en:Miya River (Mie)|Miyagawa River (Mie Prefecture)]] . The {{ill|Mie Prefectural Route 37|ja|三重県道37号鳥羽松阪線|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mie Prefectural Route 37|qq=}} runs along the northern side of the moat and serves as the route for the '''Hatsuhobiki''' (初穂曳), a festival procession held every October in conjunction with the [[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]. During this event, decorated carts carry the first harvested rice offerings to the Outer Shrine. Adjacent to the right rear of the shrine building is the auxiliary shrine of {{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}} . To the left rear stands an {{ill|Inari shrine|ja|稲荷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神}} , and to the right is a large sacred camphor tree (大楠), where many people offer prayers . Like other auxiliary shrines outside the main precincts, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya has a '''Shukueiya''' (宿衛屋), a guardhouse where Shinto priests are present during visiting hours to distribute amulets, offer kagura performances, and manage food offerings (御饌). == Worshipped Deities (Saijin) == {{see also|{{ill|Saijin|ja|祭神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saijin|qq=}}}} * [[:en:Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto]]（つきよみのみこと） * {{nihongo|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Ara-Mitama|月夜見尊荒御魂}} : {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} is the same deity as {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月讀尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}}, the enshrined deity of {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月讀宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}}, an auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naikū) of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]. He is the brother of [[:en:Amaterasu|Amaterasu Ōmikami]]. Since agricultural activities historically relied on the lunar calendar ([[:en:Lunar calendar|Lunisolar calendar]]), he has been worshipped as a deity of agriculture. Additionally, he is also considered a river deity of {{ill|Takagawara|ja|高河原|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara|qq=}} and a deity associated with women. According to the *{{ill|Jinmyō Hisho|ja|神名秘書|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jinmyō Hisho|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*, his [[:en:Shintai|Shintai]] (sacred object) is a [[:en:Mirror|mirror]]. == Festivals == The shrine follows a festival schedule similar to that of {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|ja|皇大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, with offerings from the [[:en:Imperial House of Japan|Imperial House of Japan]] during prayers for the harvest (*[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]*), seasonal festivals (*{{ill|Tsukinamisai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinamisai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}*), and major thanksgiving ceremonies (*[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* and *[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]*). * '''January''' **{{ill|Saitan-sai|ja|歳旦祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saitan-sai|qq=}}* (New Year's Festival) – [[:en:January 1|January 1]] *** A festival celebrating the new year and praying for the eternal prosperity of the imperial lineage. **{{ill|Genshi-sai|ja|元始祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Genshi-sai|qq=}}* (Imperial Foundation Festival) – [[:en:January 3|January 3]] *** A festival celebrating the origins of the imperial rule. * '''February''' **{{ill|Kenkoku Kinen-sai|ja|建国記念祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kenkoku Kinen-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (National Foundation Festival) – [[:en:February 11|February 11]] *** Celebrating the founding of Japan by [[:en:Emperor Jimmu|Emperor Jimmu]]. **[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]* (Prayer Festival) – [[:en:February 18|February 18]] *** A ceremony held early in the year to pray for abundant grain harvests and national peace. **{{ill|Tenchō-sai|ja|天長祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenchō-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天皇誕生日}}* (Emperor’s Birthday Festival) – [[:en:February 23|February 23]] *** A festival honoring the birthday of {{ill|Emperor Naruhito|ja|徳仁天皇|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Naruhito|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 徳仁}}. * '''May''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:May 14|May 14]] *** Offerings are made at the Outer Shrine, Inner Shrine, and affiliated shrines to pray for protection from storms and a bountiful harvest. * '''June''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:June 18|June 18]]–[[:en:June 19|June 19]] *** A biannual festival held in June and December to pray for the well-being of the nation and the emperor. Together with *[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]*, these are called the *Three Great Festivals* (三節祭 or 三時祭). * '''August''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:August 4|August 4]] *** A repetition of the May festival to pray for good weather and agricultural prosperity. * '''October''' **[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* (First Fruits Festival) – [[:en:October 18|October 18]]–[[:en:October 19|October 19]] *** A festival where priests present freshly harvested grains as offerings to the gods. * '''November''' **[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]* (New Harvest Festival) – [[:en:November 24|November 24]] *** A festival in which the emperor offers the season’s first grains to the gods and partakes in them as an act of gratitude. * '''December''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:December 18|December 18]]–[[:en:December 19|December 19]] === {{ill|Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Shikinen Sengu|ja|式年遷宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinen Sengu|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 遷宮}} === [[File:Sengu of Tsukiyomi no Miya, August 2014.jpg|thumb|{{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月夜見宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|2=ja|3=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}} ahead of {{ill|Ritchūsai|ja|立柱祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ritchūsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (photo taken on August 11, 2014) The shrine at the time is on the left, and the shrine under construction is on the right.]]The festivals and dates of the 62nd annual {{ill|Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Shikinen Sengu|ja|式年遷宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinen Sengu|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 遷宮}} of the {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月夜見宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|2=ja|3=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}} are as follows{{Cite web|和書|url=http://iseshima.keizai.biz/headline/2259/|title=伊勢神宮外宮別宮のもう一つの「月の神様」もお引っ越し―残すは風宮|publisher=[[伊勢志摩経済新聞]]|date=2015-03-03|accessdate=2015-03-07|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150307142246/http://iseshima.keizai.biz/headline/2259/|archivedate=2015-03-07}}{{Cite {{ill|Nokitsukesai|ja|檐付祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nokitsukesai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}（のきつけさい） * [[:en:November 5|November 5]] - {{ill|Mitosai|ja|御戸祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mitosai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}（みとさい）・{{ill|Mifunashiro 神宮式年遷宮}}（みふなしろほうのうしき）・{{ill|Araikiyome|ja|洗清|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Araikiyome|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}（あらいきよめ） * [[:en:February 27|February 27]] - {{ill|Kotsukisai|ja|杵築祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kotsukisai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}（こつきさい）・{{ill|Gochinsai|ja|後鎮祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gochinsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}（ごちんさい）・{{ill|Kawahara {{ill|Okazari|ja|御飾|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Okazari|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}（おかざり）・{{ill|Sengyo|ja|遷御|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sengyo|qq=}}（せんぎょ） * [[:en:March 1|March 1]] - {{ill|Ōmike|ja|大御饌|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmike|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}（おおみけ）・{{ill|Hōhei|ja|奉幣|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hōhei|qq=}} Above, the {{ill|Ritchūsai|ja|立柱祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ritchūsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Jōtōsai|ja|上棟祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōtōsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 上棟式}}, {{ill|Kotsukisai|ja|杵築祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kotsukisai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}, {{ill|Gochinsai|ja|後鎮祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gochinsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神宮式年遷宮}}, {{ill|Sengyo|ja|遷御|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sengyo|qq=}}, and {{ill|Hōhei|ja|奉幣|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hōhei|qq=}} were scheduled according to the divine decision (*{{ill|Gojijō|ja|御治定|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gojijō|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*) of the reigning emperor。 Additionally, on [[:en:February 22|February 22]], the *{{ill|Oshiraishi-mochi|ja|お白石持|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oshiraishi-mochi|qq=}}* ceremony took place, during which approximately 1,000 participants from the {{ill|Miyago Hōkendan|ja|宮後奉献団|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyago Hōkendan|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} carried sacred stones (*{{ill|Oshiraishi|ja|御白石|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oshiraishi|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*) in a cart from the {{ill|Urakuchi Intersection|ja|浦口交差点|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Urakuchi Intersection|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} to {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月夜見宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|2=ja|3=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}}, covering a distance of 1.2 km{{Cite web|和書|url=http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|title=次代につなぐ「エンヤ」 伊勢・月夜見宮でお白石持行事|author=中平雄大|publisher=[[中日新聞]]|date=2015-02-23|accessdate=2015-03-08|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150307161058/http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|archivedate=2015-03-07}}。 This marked the Completion tier 5]] A '''narrow, 4-meter-wide straight path''' connects the '''North Gate (北御門, Kita-mikado) of the Outer Shrine''' to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. This road is known as '''"Kamiji Street" (神路通り, Kamiji-dōri), meaning "Path of the Gods,"''' as it is '''believed to be the route taken by deities.''' See {{ill|Kamiji Street|ja|神路通り|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamiji Street|qq=}} for details. --- == Worshipers' Association (信者団体) == In '''1960 (Shōwa 35)''', a group of '''Ise City residents''' founded the '''Tsukiyomi-[[:en:Kō (lecture)|kō]] (月夜見講)''', which was later renamed the '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Hōsankai (月夜見宮奉賛会, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Worshipers' Association).''' - This organization '''holds annual thanksgiving festivals''' on '''April 19 and September 19''', among other activities. --- == Access (交通) == * '''Train:''' ** '''10-minute walk''' from '''[[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]''' (served by '''JR [[:en:Sangū Line|Sangu Line]]''' & '''Kintetsu [[:en:Yamada Line (Kintetsu)|Yamada Line]]'''). ** '''5-minute walk''' from the '''North Gate of the Outer Shrine''' via '''Kamiji Street'''. * '''Bus:''' ** '''3-minute walk''' from '''Shindō Bus Stop''' ('''[[:en:Mie Kotsu|Mie Kotsu]] Bus'''). ** '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae Bus Stop''' (served by the '''{{ill|Ise City Community Bus|ja|伊勢市コミュニティバス|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise City Community Bus|qq=}}'''). ** Note: From '''July 20, 2013''', the '''Sangu Bus''' operated by Mie Kotsu stopped at '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae''', but this service was '''discontinued on March 31, 2015'''. * '''Car:''' ** '''Approx. 3 km''' from '''{{ill|Ise Interchange|ja|伊勢インターチェンジ|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise Interchange|qq=}} (Ise Expressway).''' ** '''Parking:''' There are '''only 2-4 parking spaces in front of the torii gate''', but '''metered parking''' is available on the south side of the street. --- == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * 『月夜見宮参拝のしおり』（発行：神宮司庁） * 『お伊勢さんを歩こう』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『お伊勢まいり』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『宇治山田市史』 * 金子延夫『玉城町史 二巻 －南伊勢の歴史と伝承－』三重県郷土資料叢書第91集、三重県郷土資料刊行会、昭和58th year 12月10日 * 出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編『[[るるぶ]] お伊勢まいり』るるぶ情報版近畿21、通巻4615号、[[JTBパブリッシング]]、2014th year 5月1日、92p. ISBN 978-4-533-09761-4 * [[三橋健 (神道学者)|三橋健]]『伊勢神宮 日本人は何を祈ってきたのか』[[朝日新書]]416、[[朝日新聞出版]]、2013rd year 8月30日、230p. ISBN 978-4-02-273516-4 * 矢野憲一『伊勢神宮―知られざる杜のうち』角川選書402、[[角川学芸出版]]、平成18th year 11月10日、270p. ISBN 4-04-703402-9 * 『伊勢神宮』楽学ブックス 神社1、JTBパブリッシング、2011th year 4月1日、143p. ISBN 978-4-533-08206-1 * 『日本人なら知っておきたい 伊勢神宮と125の社』タツミムック、[[辰巳出版]]、2013rd year 11月1日、127p. ISBN 978-4-7778-1197-7 * 『いま行く!伊勢神宮お参りパーフェクトブック』みらい出版、2013rd year 12月10日、107p. ISBN 978-4-907292-14-0 == See Also == * [[:en:ツクヨミ|ツクヨミ]] * {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|ja|伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * {{ill|List of 125 Shrines of Ise|ja|神宮125社の一覧|lt=List of 125 Shrines of Ise|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|3=伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of 125 Shrines of Ise|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * [[神路通り]] == External Links == {{commonscat|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}} * [http://www.isejingu.or.jp/about/geku/tsukiyomi.html 月夜見宮] - 伊勢神宮公式サイト * [http://www.jingukaikan.jp/125mairi/m02/0202.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや） - 神宮会館] - 一般財団法人伊勢神宮崇敬会 * [http://www.ise-kanko.jp/base_data/base_data.php?info_cd=00269 伊勢市観光協会/月夜見宮] * [http://www.barifuri.com/tourcenter/data_kankou/tsukiyomi_1/index.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや）] - 伊勢志摩バリアフリーツアーセンター {{125 Shrines of Ise}} *)。 == Shrine Grounds (境内) == * '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (月夜見宮)''' - A '''Betsugū''' (auxiliary shrine) of {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]). The shrine’s '''architecture follows Shinmei-zukuri''' and features '''chigi (forked finials) cut horizontally''' and '''five katsuogi (short decorative logs)''', '''a thatched roof''', and '''a south-facing orientation'''. ** '''Shikinen Sengu (式年遷宮)''': The shrine is '''reconstructed every 20 years''' according to the ancient practice of '''Shikinen Sengu'''. The '''former shrine grounds''' (古殿地, kodenchi) are located directly to the east and west of the current shrine. ** '''Traditional Legend''': It is said that in the past, when the people of '''Miyago Town''' were carrying '''sacred timber (役木, yakugi)''' for shrine reconstruction, they '''passed through Yokaichiba Town'''. At that moment, '''a fire broke out in Miyago Town''', and the timber carriers '''rushed back to extinguish it'''. As a result, the people of Yokaichiba took over the role of '''carrying the sacred timber'''. Since then, in the '''Okihikizome-shiki (御木曳初式, First Timber-Carrying Ceremony)''', '''the people of Yokaichiba''' have traditionally taken on the '''honor of bringing the sacred timber to Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. * '''{{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}}''' - Dedicated to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto no Mitama (月夜見尊御魂, Spirit of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto)'''. Though located within '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''', it is actually '''a Sessha (摂社, auxiliary shrine) of Toyouke Daijingu (Outer Shrine).''' * '''{{ill|Inari Shrine|ja|稲荷社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神社}}''' – A shrine dedicated to '''Inari''', the deity of '''prosperity and agriculture'''. * '''Shukueya (宿衛屋)''' – A '''guardhouse''' for shrine officials. --- == Kamiji Street (神路通り) == [[File:Kamiji Street from Tsukiyomi no Miya.jpg|thumb|Kamiji Street]] }} {{translated page|ja|月夜見宮|qq=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|qq=ja|qq=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|version=99549095|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category: of the *Oshiraishi-mochi* ceremonies for all auxiliary shrines (*{{ill|Betsugū|ja|別宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Betsugū|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} [[ja:月夜見宮]] [[sn:Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)]] [[Category:Built in Japan in 2015]] [[Category:Shikinaisha in Ise Province]] [[Category:Shrines in Ise City]] [[Category:125 Shrines of Ise]] {{Commons category|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}}

社殿 |名称 = 月夜見宮 |所在地 = [[三重県]][[Ise, Mie]]宮後一丁目3-19 |位置 = {{ウィキ座標2段度分秒|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E|display=inline,title}} |祭神 = [[:en:ツクヨミ|月夜見尊]]
月夜見尊荒御魂 |社格 = {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳}}（小）
{{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}別宮 |創建 = [[延長 (元号)|延長]]5th year （[[927]]）以前 |本殿 = [[神明造]] |例祭= |地図 = {{location map|Japan Mie|lat_deg=34|lat_min=29|lat_sec=34.7|lon_deg=136|lon_min=42|lon_sec=21.3|label=月夜見宮|position=top|width=200|float=center|caption=|mark=Shinto torii icon vermillion.svg|marksize=20}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E}}}} }} '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''' (月夜見宮) is a [[Shinto shrine|shrine]] located in Miyago, Ise City, Mie Prefecture辰巳出版（2013）：16ページ. It is a [[:en:Betsugū|Betsugū]] of [[Ise Grand Shrine|Ise Jingu]] {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine)伊勢文化舎 編（2008）：39ページみらい出版（2013）：64ページ学研パブリッシング（2013）：69ページJTBパブリッシング（2011）：42ページ出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編（2014）：34ページ三橋（2013）：124ページ。 It is a [[Shikinaisha]]. == Overview == [[File:Tsukiyomi-nomiya(Geku)_00.JPG|thumb|300px|right|Aerial view of Tsukiyomi-no-Miya]] Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is an auxiliary shrine (betsugu) of the Outer Shrine (Geku), located about 300 meters north of Geku and approximately 500 meters west of [[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]. It enshrines two deities within the same shrine building: {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} (Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) and his fierce spirit, '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Aramitama''' (荒御魂 of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) . Unlike the {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|ja|月讀宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|qq=}} auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naiku), where Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto and his Aramitama are enshrined separately, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya uniquely houses both deities within a single structure . The only other auxiliary shrines that enshrine two deities in one building are {{ill|Kaze-no-Miya|ja|風宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaze-no-Miya|qq=}} (Kaze-no-Miya) of the Outer Shrine and {{ill|Kazahinomi-no-Miya|ja|風日祈宮|lt=Kazahi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-no-Miya|qq=}} of the Inner Shrine, both enshrining Shinatsuhiko-no-Mikoto (級長津彦命) and Shinatsuhime-no-Mikoto (級長戸辺命). Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is the only auxiliary shrine of the Outer Shrine located outside the main precincts . Despite being in the urban area of Ise City, its grounds maintain a serene atmosphere . The moat surrounding three sides of the precinct is thought to be a remnant of a tributary of the [[:en:Miya River (Mie)|Miyagawa River (Mie Prefecture)]] . The {{ill|Mie Prefectural Route 37|ja|三重県道37号鳥羽松阪線|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mie Prefectural Route 37|qq=}} runs along the northern side of the moat and serves as the route for the '''Hatsuhobiki''' (初穂曳), a festival procession held every October in conjunction with the [[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]. During this event, decorated carts carry the first harvested rice offerings to the Outer Shrine. Adjacent to the right rear of the shrine building is the auxiliary shrine of {{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}} . To the left rear stands an {{ill|Inari shrine|ja|稲荷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神}} , and to the right is a large sacred camphor tree (大楠), where many people offer prayers . Like other auxiliary shrines outside the main precincts, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya has a '''Shukueiya''' (宿衛屋), a guardhouse where Shinto priests are present during visiting hours to distribute amulets, offer kagura performances, and manage food offerings (御饌). == Worshipped Deities (Saijin) == {{see also|{{ill|Saijin|ja|祭神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saijin|qq=}}}} * [[:en:Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto]]（つきよみのみこと） * {{nihongo|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Ara-Mitama|月夜見尊荒御魂}} : {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} is the same deity as {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月讀尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}}, the enshrined deity of {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月讀宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}}, an auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naikū) of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]. He is the brother of [[:en:Amaterasu|Amaterasu Ōmikami]]. Since agricultural activities historically relied on the lunar calendar ([[:en:Lunar calendar|Lunisolar calendar]]), he has been worshipped as a deity of agriculture. Additionally, he is also considered a river deity of {{ill|Takagawara|ja|高河原|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara|qq=}} and a deity associated with women. According to the *{{ill|Jinmyō Hisho|ja|神名秘書|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jinmyō Hisho|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*, his [[:en:Shintai|Shintai]] (sacred object) is a [[:en:Mirror|mirror]]. == Festivals == The shrine follows a festival schedule similar to that of {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|ja|皇大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, with offerings from the [[:en:Imperial House of Japan|Imperial House of Japan]] during prayers for the harvest (*[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]*), seasonal festivals (*{{ill|Tsukinamisai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinamisai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}*), and major thanksgiving ceremonies (*[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* and *[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]*). * '''January''' **{{ill|Saitan-sai|ja|歳旦祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saitan-sai|qq=}}* (New Year's Festival) – [[:en:January 1|January 1]] *** A festival celebrating the new year and praying for the eternal prosperity of the imperial lineage. **{{ill|Genshi-sai|ja|元始祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Genshi-sai|qq=}}* (Imperial Foundation Festival) – [[:en:January 3|January 3]] *** A festival celebrating the origins of the imperial rule. * '''February''' **{{ill|Kenkoku Kinen-sai|ja|建国記念祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kenkoku Kinen-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (National Foundation Festival) – [[:en:February 11|February 11]] *** Celebrating the founding of Japan by [[:en:Emperor Jimmu|Emperor Jimmu]]. **[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]* (Prayer Festival) – [[:en:February 18|February 18]] *** A ceremony held early in the year to pray for abundant grain harvests and national peace. **{{ill|Tenchō-sai|ja|天長祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenchō-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天皇誕生日}}* (Emperor’s Birthday Festival) – [[:en:February 23|February 23]] *** A festival honoring the birthday of {{ill|Emperor Naruhito|ja|徳仁天皇|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Naruhito|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 徳仁}}. * '''May''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:May 14|May 14]] *** Offerings are made at the Outer Shrine, Inner Shrine, and affiliated shrines to pray for protection from storms and a bountiful harvest. * '''June''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:June 18|June 18]]–[[:en:June 19|June 19]] *** A biannual festival held in June and December to pray for the well-being of the nation and the emperor. Together with *[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]*, these are called the *Three Great Festivals* (三節祭 or 三時祭). * '''August''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:August 4|August 4]] *** A repetition of the May festival to pray for good weather and agricultural prosperity. * '''October''' **[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* (First Fruits Festival) – [[:en:October 18|October 18]]–[[:en:October 19|October 19]] *** A festival where priests present freshly harvested grains as offerings to the gods. * '''November''' **[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]* (New Harvest Festival) – [[:en:November 24|November 24]] *** A festival in which the emperor offers the season’s first grains to the gods and partakes in them as an act of gratitude. * '''December''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:December 伊勢・月夜見宮でお白石持行事|author=中平雄大|publisher=[[中日新聞]]|date=2015-02-23|accessdate=2015-03-08|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150307161058/http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|archivedate=2015-03-07}}。 This marked the Completion tier 5]] A '''narrow, 4-meter-wide straight path''' connects the '''North Gate (北御門, Kita-mikado) of the Outer Shrine''' to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. This road is known as '''"Kamiji Street" (神路通り, Kamiji-dōri), meaning "Path of the Gods,"''' as it is '''believed to be the route taken by deities.''' See {{ill|Kamiji Street|ja|神路通り|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamiji Street|qq=}} for details. --- == Worshipers' Association (信者団体) == In '''1960 (Shōwa 35)''', a group of '''Ise City residents''' founded the '''Tsukiyomi-[[:en:Kō (lecture)|kō]] (月夜見講)''', which was later renamed the '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Hōsankai (月夜見宮奉賛会, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Worshipers' Association).''' - This organization '''holds annual thanksgiving festivals''' on '''April 19 and September 19''', among other activities. --- == Access (交通) == * '''Train:''' ** '''10-minute walk''' from '''[[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]''' (served by '''JR [[:en:Sangū Line|Sangu Line]]''' & '''Kintetsu [[:en:Yamada Line (Kintetsu)|Yamada Line]]'''). ** '''5-minute walk''' from the '''North Gate of the Outer Shrine''' via '''Kamiji Street'''. * '''Bus:''' ** '''3-minute walk''' from '''Shindō Bus Stop''' ('''[[:en:Mie Kotsu|Mie Kotsu]] Bus'''). ** '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae Bus Stop''' (served by the '''{{ill|Ise City Community Bus|ja|伊勢市コミュニティバス|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise City Community Bus|qq=}}'''). ** Note: From '''July 20, 2013''', the '''Sangu Bus''' operated by Mie Kotsu stopped at '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae''', but this service was '''discontinued on March 31, 2015'''. * '''Car:''' ** '''Approx. 3 km''' from '''{{ill|Ise Interchange|ja|伊勢インターチェンジ|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise Interchange|qq=}} (Ise Expressway).''' ** '''Parking:''' There are '''only 2-4 parking spaces in front of the torii gate''', but '''metered parking''' is available on the south side of the street. --- == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * 『月夜見宮参拝のしおり』（発行：神宮司庁） * 『お伊勢さんを歩こう』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『お伊勢まいり』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『宇治山田市史』 * 金子延夫『玉城町史 二巻 －南伊勢の歴史と伝承－』三重県郷土資料叢書第91集、三重県郷土資料刊行会、昭和58th year 12月10日 * 出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編『[[るるぶ]] お伊勢まいり』るるぶ情報版近畿21、通巻4615号、[[JTBパブリッシング]]、2014th year 5月1日、92p. ISBN 978-4-533-09761-4 * [[三橋健 (神道学者)|三橋健]]『伊勢神宮 日本人は何を祈ってきたのか』[[朝日新書]]416、[[朝日新聞出版]]、2013rd year 8月30日、230p. ISBN 978-4-02-273516-4 * 矢野憲一『伊勢神宮―知られざる杜のうち』角川選書402、[[角川学芸出版]]、平成18th year 11月10日、270p. ISBN 978-4-907292-14-0 == See Also == * [[:en:ツクヨミ|ツクヨミ]] * {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|ja|伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * {{ill|List of 125 Shrines of Ise|ja|神宮125社の一覧|lt=List of 125 Shrines of Ise|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|3=伊勢国の式内社一覧|1=List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of 125 Shrines of Ise|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Shikinaisha in Ise Province|qq=}} * [[神路通り]] == External Links == {{commonscat|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}} * [http://www.isejingu.or.jp/about/geku/tsukiyomi.html 月夜見宮] - 伊勢神宮公式サイト * [http://www.jingukaikan.jp/125mairi/m02/0202.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや） - 神宮会館] - 一般財団法人伊勢神宮崇敬会 * [http://www.ise-kanko.jp/base_data/base_data.php?info_cd=00269 伊勢市観光協会/月夜見宮] * [http://www.barifuri.com/tourcenter/data_kankou/tsukiyomi_1/index.html 月夜見宮（つきよみのみや）] - 伊勢志摩バリアフリーツアーセンター {{125 Shrines of Ise}} *)。 == Shrine Grounds (境内) == * '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (月夜見宮)''' - A '''Betsugū''' (auxiliary shrine) of {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]). The shrine’s '''architecture follows Shinmei-zukuri''' and features '''chigi (forked finials) cut horizontally''' and '''five katsuogi (short decorative logs)''', '''a thatched roof''', and '''a south-facing orientation'''. ** '''Shikinen Sengu (式年遷宮)''': The shrine is '''reconstructed every 20 years''' according to the ancient practice of '''Shikinen Sengu'''. The '''former shrine grounds''' (古殿地, kodenchi) are located directly to the east and west of the current shrine. ** '''Traditional Legend''': It is said that in the past, when the people of '''Miyago Town''' were carrying '''sacred timber (役木, yakugi)''' for shrine reconstruction, they '''passed through Yokaichiba Town'''. At that moment, '''a fire broke out in Miyago Town''', and the timber carriers '''rushed back to extinguish it'''. As a result, the people of Yokaichiba took over the role of '''carrying the sacred timber'''. Since then, in the '''Okihikizome-shiki (御木曳初式, First Timber-Carrying Ceremony)''', '''the people of Yokaichiba''' have traditionally taken on the '''honor of bringing the sacred timber to Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. * '''{{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}}''' - Dedicated to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto no Mitama (月夜見尊御魂, Spirit of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto)'''. Though located within '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''', it is actually '''a Sessha (摂社, auxiliary shrine) of Toyouke Daijingu (Outer Shrine).''' * '''{{ill|Inari Shrine|ja|稲荷社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神社}}''' – A shrine dedicated to '''Inari''', the deity of '''prosperity and agriculture'''. * '''Shukueya (宿衛屋)''' – A '''guardhouse''' for shrine officials. --- == Kamiji Street (神路通り) == [[File:Kamiji Street from Tsukiyomi no Miya.jpg|thumb|Kamiji Street]] }} {{translated page|ja|月夜見宮|qq=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|qq=ja|qq=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|version=99549095|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category: of the *Oshiraishi-mochi* ceremonies for all auxiliary shrines (*{{ill|Betsugū|ja|別宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Betsugū|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} [[ja:月夜見宮]] [[sn:Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)]] [[Category:Built in Japan in 2015]] [[Category:Shikinaisha in Ise Province]] [[Category:Shinto shrines in Ise City]] [[Category:125 Shrines of Ise]] {{Commons category|Tsukiyomi-no-miya (Geku)}}

{{distinguish|{{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|ja|月讀宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|2=es|3=Tsukiyomi no miya (Naikū)|4=ja|5=月讀宮|lkt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|qq=}}}} {{混同|月讀宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|2=es|3=Tsukiyomi no miya (Naikū)|4=ja|5=月讀宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya}} {{神社 | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Geku Tsukiyomi no Miya in October 2016.jpg|270px]]
社殿 |名称 = 月夜見宮 |所在地 = [[三重県]][[Ise, Mie]]宮後一丁目3-19 |位置 = {{ウィキ座標2段度分秒|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E|display=inline,title}} |祭神 = [[:en:ツクヨミ|月夜見尊]]
月夜見尊荒御魂 |社格 = {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|lt=Shikinaisha}}（小）
{{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}別宮 |創建 = [[延長 (元号)|延長]]5th year （[[927]]）以前 |本殿 = [[神明造]] |例祭= |地図 = {{location map|Japan Mie|lat_deg=34|lat_min=29|lat_sec=34.7|lon_deg=136|lon_min=42|lon_sec=21.3|label=月夜見宮|position=top|width=200|float=center|caption=|mark=Shinto torii icon vermillion.svg|marksize=20}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|29|34.7|N|136|42|21.3|E}}}} }} '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya''' (月夜見宮) is a [[Shinto shrine|shrine]] located in Miyago, Ise City, Mie Prefecture辰巳出版（2013）：16ページ. It is a [[:en:Betsugū|Betsugū]] of [[Ise Grand Shrine|Ise Jingu]] {{ill|Toyouke Daijingu|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyouke Daijingu|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Daijingu|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (Outer Shrine)伊勢文化舎 編（2008）：39ページみらい出版（2013）：64ページ学研パブリッシング（2013）：69ページJTBパブリッシング（2011）：42ページ出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編（2014）：34ページ三橋（2013）：124ページ。 It is a [[Shikinaisha]]. == Overview == [[File:Tsukiyomi-nomiya(Geku)_00.JPG|thumb|300px|right|Aerial view of Tsukiyomi-no-Miya]] Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is an auxiliary shrine (betsugu) of the Outer Shrine (Geku), located about 300 meters north of Geku and approximately 500 meters west of [[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]. It enshrines two deities within the same shrine building: {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} (Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) and his fierce spirit, '''Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Aramitama''' (荒御魂 of Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto) . Unlike the {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|ja|月讀宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Naiku)|qq=}} auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naiku), where Tsukiyomi-no-Mikoto and his Aramitama are enshrined separately, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya uniquely houses both deities within a single structure . The only other auxiliary shrines that enshrine two deities in one building are {{ill|Kaze-no-Miya|ja|風宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaze-no-Miya|qq=}} (Kaze-no-Miya) of the Outer Shrine and {{ill|Kazahinomi-no-Miya|ja|風日祈宮|lt=Kazahi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-no-Miya|qq=}} of the Inner Shrine, both enshrining Shinatsuhiko-no-Mikoto (級長津彦命) and Shinatsuhime-no-Mikoto (級長戸辺命). Tsukiyomi-no-Miya is the only auxiliary shrine of the Outer Shrine located outside the main precincts . Despite being in the urban area of Ise City, its grounds maintain a serene atmosphere . The moat surrounding three sides of the precinct is thought to be a remnant of a tributary of the [[:en:Miya River (Mie)|Miyagawa River (Mie Prefecture)]] . The {{ill|Mie Prefectural Route 37|ja|三重県道37号鳥羽松阪線|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mie Prefectural Route 37|qq=}} runs along the northern side of the moat and serves as the route for the '''Hatsuhobiki''' (初穂曳), a festival procession held every October in conjunction with the [[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]. During this event, decorated carts carry the first harvested rice offerings to the Outer Shrine. Adjacent to the right rear of the shrine building is the auxiliary shrine of {{ill|Takagawara Shrine|ja|高河原神社|comment=no clue what happened there|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara Shrine|qq=}} . To the left rear stands an {{ill|Inari shrine|ja|稲荷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inari shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 稲荷神}} , and to the right is a large sacred camphor tree (大楠), where many people offer prayers . Like other auxiliary shrines outside the main precincts, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya has a '''Shukueiya''' (宿衛屋), a guardhouse where Shinto priests are present during visiting hours to distribute amulets, offer kagura performances, and manage food offerings (御饌). == Worshipped Deities (Saijin) == {{see also|{{ill|Saijin|ja|祭神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saijin|qq=}}}} * [[:en:Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto]]（つきよみのみこと） * {{nihongo|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto-no-Ara-Mitama|月夜見尊荒御魂}} : {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月夜見尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}} is the same deity as {{ill|Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|ja|月讀尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ツクヨミ}}, the enshrined deity of {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月讀宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}}, an auxiliary shrine of the Inner Shrine (Naikū) of [[:en:Ise Shrine|Ise Grand Shrine]]. He is the brother of [[:en:Amaterasu|Amaterasu Ōmikami]]. Since agricultural activities historically relied on the lunar calendar ([[:en:Lunar calendar|Lunisolar calendar]]), he has been worshipped as a deity of agriculture. Additionally, he is also considered a river deity of {{ill|Takagawara|ja|高河原|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takagawara|qq=}} and a deity associated with women. According to the *{{ill|Jinmyō Hisho|ja|神名秘書|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jinmyō Hisho|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}*, his [[:en:Shintai|Shintai]] (sacred object) is a [[:en:Mirror|mirror]]. == Festivals == The shrine follows a festival schedule similar to that of {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|ja|皇大神宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, with offerings from the [[:en:Imperial House of Japan|Imperial House of Japan]] during prayers for the harvest (*[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]*), seasonal festivals (*{{ill|Tsukinamisai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinamisai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}*), and major thanksgiving ceremonies (*[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* and *[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]*). * '''January''' **{{ill|Saitan-sai|ja|歳旦祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saitan-sai|qq=}}* (New Year's Festival) – [[:en:January 1|January 1]] *** A festival celebrating the new year and praying for the eternal prosperity of the imperial lineage. **{{ill|Genshi-sai|ja|元始祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Genshi-sai|qq=}}* (Imperial Foundation Festival) – [[:en:January 3|January 3]] *** A festival celebrating the origins of the imperial rule. * '''February''' **{{ill|Kenkoku Kinen-sai|ja|建国記念祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kenkoku Kinen-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (National Foundation Festival) – [[:en:February 11|February 11]] *** Celebrating the founding of Japan by [[:en:Emperor Jimmu|Emperor Jimmu]]. **[[:en:Kinen-sai|Kinensai]]* (Prayer Festival) – [[:en:February 18|February 18]] *** A ceremony held early in the year to pray for abundant grain harvests and national peace. **{{ill|Tenchō-sai|ja|天長祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenchō-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天皇誕生日}}* (Emperor’s Birthday Festival) – [[:en:February 23|February 23]] *** A festival honoring the birthday of {{ill|Emperor Naruhito|ja|徳仁天皇|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Naruhito|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 徳仁}}. * '''May''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:May 14|May 14]] *** Offerings are made at the Outer Shrine, Inner Shrine, and affiliated shrines to pray for protection from storms and a bountiful harvest. * '''June''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:June 18|June 18]]–[[:en:June 19|June 19]] *** A biannual festival held in June and December to pray for the well-being of the nation and the emperor. Together with *[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]*, these are called the *Three Great Festivals* (三節祭 or 三時祭). * '''August''' **{{ill|Kazahinomi-sai|ja|風日祈祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kazahinomi-sai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}* (Wind and Sun Festival) – [[:en:August 4|August 4]] *** A repetition of the May festival to pray for good weather and agricultural prosperity. * '''October''' **[[:en:Kannamesai Festival|Kannamesai]]* (First Fruits Festival) – [[:en:October 18|October 18]]–[[:en:October 19|October 19]] *** A festival where priests present freshly harvested grains as offerings to the gods. * '''November''' **[[:en:Niiname-no-Matsuri|Niinamesai]]* (New Harvest Festival) – [[:en:November 24|November 24]] *** A festival in which the emperor offers the season’s first grains to the gods and partakes in them as an act of gratitude. * '''December''' **{{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-sai|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}}* (Monthly Festival) – [[:en:December 18|December 18]]–[[:en:December 19|December 19]] === {{ill|Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Shikinen Sengu|ja|式年遷宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinen Sengu|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 遷宮}} === [[File:Sengu of Tsukiyomi no Miya, August 2014.jpg|thumb|{{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月夜見宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|2=ja|3=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}} ahead of {{ill|Ritchūsai|ja|立柱祭|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ritchūsai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (photo taken on August 11, 2014) The shrine at the time is on the left, and the shrine under construction is on the right.]]The festivals and dates of the 62nd annual {{ill|Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Jingū Shikinen Sengū|lt=Shikinen Sengu|ja|式年遷宮|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinen Sengu|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 遷宮}} of the {{ill|Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|ja|月夜見宮|1=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya (Geku)|2=ja|3=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}} are as follows{{Cite web|和書|url=http://iseshima.keizai.biz/headline/2259/|title=伊勢神宮外宮別宮のもう一つの「月の神様」もお引っ越し―残すは風宮|publisher=[[伊勢志摩経済新聞]]|date=2015-03-03|accessdate=2015-03-07|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150307142246/http://iseshima.keizai.biz/headline/2259/|archivedate=2015-03-07}}{{Cite web|和書|url=http://www.isejingu.or.jp/sikinen_2.html|title=月讀宮以下12別宮の遷宮 - (Geku)|2=ja|3=月夜見宮|lt=Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukiyomi-no-Miya|qq=}}, covering a distance of 1.2 km{{Cite web|和書|url=http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|title=次代につなぐ「エンヤ」 伊勢・月夜見宮でお白石持行事|author=中平雄大|publisher=[[中日新聞]]|date=2015-02-23|accessdate=2015-03-08|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150307161058/http://www.chunichi.co.jp/article/mie/20150223/CK2015022302000028.html|archivedate=2015-03-07}}。 This marked the Completion tier 5]] A '''narrow, 4-meter-wide straight path''' connects the '''North Gate (北御門, Kita-mikado) of the Outer Shrine''' to '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya'''. This road is known as '''"Kamiji Street" (神路通り, Kamiji-dōri), meaning "Path of the Gods,"''' as it is '''believed to be the route taken by deities.''' See {{ill|Kamiji Street|ja|神路通り|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamiji Street|qq=}} for details. --- == Worshipers' Association (信者団体) == In '''1960 (Shōwa 35)''', a group of '''Ise City residents''' founded the '''Tsukiyomi-[[:en:Kō (lecture)|kō]] (月夜見講)''', which was later renamed the '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Hōsankai (月夜見宮奉賛会, Tsukiyomi-no-Miya Worshipers' Association).''' - This organization '''holds annual thanksgiving festivals''' on '''April 19 and September 19''', among other activities. --- == Access (交通) == * '''Train:''' ** '''10-minute walk''' from '''[[:en:Iseshi Station|Ise City Station]]''' (served by '''JR [[:en:Sangū Line|Sangu Line]]''' & '''Kintetsu [[:en:Yamada Line (Kintetsu)|Yamada Line]]'''). ** '''5-minute walk''' from the '''North Gate of the Outer Shrine''' via '''Kamiji Street'''. * '''Bus:''' ** '''3-minute walk''' from '''Shindō Bus Stop''' ('''[[:en:Mie Kotsu|Mie Kotsu]] Bus'''). ** '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae Bus Stop''' (served by the '''{{ill|Ise City Community Bus|ja|伊勢市コミュニティバス|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise City Community Bus|qq=}}'''). ** Note: From '''July 20, 2013''', the '''Sangu Bus''' operated by Mie Kotsu stopped at '''Tsukiyomi-no-Miya-mae''', but this service was '''discontinued on March 31, 2015'''. * '''Car:''' ** '''Approx. 3 km''' from '''{{ill|Ise Interchange|ja|伊勢インターチェンジ|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise Interchange|qq=}} (Ise Expressway).''' ** '''Parking:''' There are '''only 2-4 parking spaces in front of the torii gate''', but '''metered parking''' is available on the south side of the street. --- == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * 『月夜見宮参拝のしおり』（発行：神宮司庁） * 『お伊勢さんを歩こう』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『お伊勢まいり』（発行：伊勢神宮崇敬会） * 『宇治山田市史』 * 金子延夫『玉城町史 二巻 －南伊勢の歴史と伝承－』三重県郷土資料叢書第91集、三重県郷土資料刊行会、昭和58th year 12月10日 * 出版事業本部 国内情報部 第三編集部 編『[[るるぶ]] お伊勢まいり』るるぶ情報版近畿21、通巻4615号、[[JTBパブリッシング]]、2014th year 5月1日、92p.
